name: Expensify
description: Expensify is an expense management platform that uses receipt scanning and its Concierge automation to build expense reports, paired with its own commercial card, bill pay, invoicing, and in-app travel booking.
best_for: Businesses and individuals wanting receipt-scanning-driven expense reports, with subscription discounts for companies that adopt the Expensify Card.
pros: Collect plan is a flat $5/member/month with no annual commitment
Control plan subscription cost can drop as low as $9/member/month (annual) with heavy Expensify Card usage
45+ integrations including QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Xero, Workday, and Gusto
cons: Without the Expensify Card, Control plan pricing is $18/member/month annual or $36/member/month pay-per-use
The deepest subscription discounts require routing company card spend through the Expensify Card
Advanced controls (custom approval workflows, tax tracking, ERP-grade sync) are gated behind the higher-priced Control plan
features: Receipt scanning via mobile app, email forwarding, or drag-and-drop with Concierge-automated categorization
Expense report submission, multi-level approval workflows, and direct-to-bank reimbursement
Expensify Visa Commercial Card with cash back and unlimited free virtual cards for Card members
In-app booking for flights, hotels, cars, and rail with automatic travel-expense sync
45+ integrations, including QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Xero, Workday, and Gusto

tiers.name: Submit
tiers.notes: Free workspace for an individual employee tracking their own expenses, with limited features.

tiers.name: Collect
tiers.notes: Flat rate with no annual commitment, including for customers not using the Expensify Card. In effect for signups after April 1, 2025.

tiers.name: Control (annual, with Expensify Card)
tiers.notes: "As low as" price; the discount (up to 50%) scales with the share of approved USD expenses charged to the Expensify Card that billing month.

tiers.name: Control (annual, no card)
tiers.notes: Annual subscription without Expensify Card usage.

tiers.name: Control (pay-per-use)
tiers.notes: No annual commitment; drops to "as low as" $18/member/month with heavy Expensify Card usage.

alternatives.name: Ramp
alternatives.description: A spend management platform combining a fee-free corporate card with AI-driven expense, AP, and procurement automation.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting a free corporate card paired with automated expense and accounts-payable workflows.
strengths: Free plan with no annual fees or interest charges on the card
Zero processing fees on domestic ACH, check, and card AP payments
Native bidirectional sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct

alternatives.name: Brex
alternatives.description: A corporate card and spend management platform with a free entry tier and AI-driven expense automation.
alternatives.best_for: Startups and scaling companies wanting a free corporate card plus bill pay and travel in one platform.
strengths: AI-powered bill pay and GL coding

alternatives.name: Navan
alternatives.description: An AI-assisted corporate travel booking and expense management platform, formerly TripActions.
alternatives.best_for: Companies wanting travel booking and expense management combined, with free travel booking for companies up to 300 employees.
strengths: Free travel booking for companies up to 300 employees
AI-driven expense categorization and policy-violation flagging

alternatives.name: SAP Concur
alternatives.description: SAP's travel, expense, and invoice management suite, sold as separate Concur Travel, Concur Expense, and Concur Invoice products.
alternatives.best_for: Larger organizations wanting travel booking, expense, and AP invoice automation as one SAP-integrated suite rather than a standalone expense app.
strengths: Combined travel, expense, and AP invoice suite
Deep policy enforcement and audit tooling (Concur Detect)
